1.title: It started with one act of fury.
1.copy: In 2021, watching Japanese entrepreneurs, we wrote something down. There are people who can compete globally. There is excellent technology. And still, that value never reaches the world.
1.quoteBefore: ...this club's stance of make themselves notable around the globe is astonishingly weak.
1.quoteAfter: Why the most of Japanese elites doesn't have the ambition to rule the world?

2.title: We went out into the world and learned what stood in the way.
2.copy: San Francisco, Denver, Bangkok. Not as attendees, but as builders. We learned firsthand what the walls were made of: language, borders, information, networks.
2.imgLgAlt: A view over the ETH San Francisco venue
2.imgSm1Alt: The entrance to the ETH Denver venue

3.title: We built spaces and walked across Japan.
3.copy: A symposium in Ishigaki made the local paper; a sake brewery in Kagawa let us touch the memory held in the land. Value isn't scarce -- it just isn't found, told, or met.
3.imgLgAlt: Kazuma Tamura speaking on a DAO panel at ETHTokyo
3.imgSm1Alt: Speaking surrounded by tanks at a sake brewery in Kagawa

4.title: We built the place to meet.
4.copy: Our own international conference. At Google for Startups Campus Tokyo, we put builders from abroad and Japanese companies in the same room.
4.imgLgAlt: The full venue and group photo of speakers and attendees at FA1RNESS 2024

5.title: What we'd been searching for in the digital world, we found in a small factory.
5.copy: Ota Ward's small factories had "nakama-mawashi" -- the distributed collaboration we'd chased across the DAO world had been running as a real industry in Japanese manufacturing for decades. That's where A-one Road's path came together into one line.
5.imgLgAlt: Visiting a craftsman at work in a small factory in Ota Ward
5.imgSmAlt: A workshop covered in whiteboard notes

main.copy: Technology accumulated in factories. Services that exist abroad but haven't reached Japan. Knowledge and time buried inside companies. Borders, language, industry, organization -- we remove the walls between them and deliver value to where it's needed.

main.title: Slow inquiry and quote response is straining your core work.
main.copy: For low-volume high-mix operations, the real bottleneck usually isn't generating new leads -- it's the first response to the inquiries and quote requests already coming in. We combine overseas SaaS and AI with your existing operations, diagnosing everything from on-site hearing to ROI modeling to identifying which budget it replaces.

main.title: First, an on-site hearing.
main.copy: We bridge language, trust, and how decisions get made — in Japanese and in English.
main.lead: What we deliver first is the on-site data and analysis needed to judge the shortest path to ROI. We stay neutral across manufacturers, so the conclusion can be "don't adopt anything right now."

main.title: From on-site hearing to reallocating your budget.
main.copy: We turn burdens people describe by feel into numbers.

1.title: On-site hearing
1.copy: We ask who spends how much time on inquiry response and follow-up, by department and by person.

2.title: Workload analysis
2.copy: We break down the workflow into person-months, cost, and lost revenue -- turning felt burden into numbers.

4.title: ROI modeling
4.copy: We calculate person-months saved, annual impact, and payback period across conservative, standard, and optimistic scenarios.

5.title: Budget replacement mapping
5.copy: We identify existing budget -- overtime, temp staffing, outsourcing -- that could fund the replacement, without assuming new budget.

7.title: Product selection & rollout
7.copy: Based on the diagnostic, we select the best-fitting product from candidates worldwide and see it through to adoption.

main.title: Two areas we run this for.

main.message: Country Manager as a Service for Japan. We source proven overseas machines, AI, and SaaS and take them through selection, deployment, and operation for Japanese businesses.

main.label: Strengthening Japanese factories with overseas technology.
main.sub: We bring overseas industrial machines, robotics, AI, and manufacturing SaaS into Japanese factories -- selection through deployment and operation.

main.label: Running sales and back-office work, end to end.
main.sub: We bring overseas AI and SaaS for sales, hiring, and back-office work into Japanese companies, combined with the operations needed to actually run it.

main.title: We meet factory floor problems with overseas technology.
main.copy: Manual dependence, tribal knowledge, downtime, disconnected production lines. From slow quoting to DX to new equipment, we source proven overseas machines, AI, and SaaS and take them through selection, deployment, and operation on Japan's factory floor.

main.title: We don't limit ourselves to one technology.
main.copy: Additive manufacturing, DX tools, production management systems, automated inspection -- we search worldwide for whatever fits your problem. We stay neutral across manufacturers and technologies.

main.title: Examples of what we take on
main.note: Every company's actual problem is different. Tell us where you stand first.

1.title: Quoting & order DX
1.copy: We use overseas SaaS and AI to streamline quoting and order handling that has stayed tribal knowledge.

2.title: Downtime reduction & line fixes
2.copy: We identify the processes and equipment dragging down utilization and bring in the technology to fix them.

3.title: Large-format additive manufacturing (LFAM/WAAM)
3.copy: Instead of storing large molds and jigs, we offer the option to print them on demand when needed.

main.copy: The common thread: making the burden on the ground visible, and turning it into lower fixed costs and fewer lost opportunities.

main.title: All the numbers up front
main.copy: After hearing your process, equipment, and budget, we share the expected return and the steps to deployment up front. If we don't expect it to work, we say so directly.

main.title: We judge fit before you commit
main.copy: We screen against the process content, lot volume, and current cost/lead time to judge whether an overseas technology will actually help. Telling you it is not a fit when it is not is part of the job.

main.title: Your guide, not a seller
main.copy: We are not an exclusive agent for any single manufacturer. We work non-exclusively, case by case, to bridge you to overseas manufacturers -- building a project brief from your requirements and connecting you directly with the manufacturer's team, designed alongside Japan's existing machining network.

main.title: Tell us about your process -- 30 minutes no charge
main.copy: A free 30-minute hearing on your target process. If there is potential a paid on-site diagnosis (quoted individually) delivers candidate processes rough impact estimates and a manufacturer-ready brief.
